decisions.rationale: Make admissible tradeoffs and uncertainty decidable, not universal Uместность or an intelligence score.
decisions.impact: Primary conditional eligibility and E07 outcomes; no threshold tuning to make B3 win. Actual operational truth not identified.

decisions.decision: Comparator findings first; REDUNDANT against B2 OR B4; formal B1 contrast for H0-COMPUTE; definite harm need not cost more; add MIXED_TRADEOFF and NO_STRUCTURAL_ADVANTAGE.
decisions.rationale: Preserve falsifiers, avoid hiding losses in nonsignificance or uncertainty.
decisions.impact: Evaluation taxonomy only; not a canonical model entity.

decisions.decision: One seed preimage for TASK_ID and all streams; F1 cyclic-only coordinate symmetry; F2 private solution-anchored exact alpha-canonicalization n!*k! candidates.

decisions.decision: Architecture-package effect != update/action association != causal external-profile role != internal mechanism.

decisions.impact: Synthetic shortcut detection is not empirical exclusion of shortcut; future scientific change requires author decision.

decisions.decision: BOUNDED_EVIDENCE_PROBE: mismatch -> competing explanations -> need for evidence -> bounded probe -> returned observation -> profile consequence -> behavioral consequence -> stop. Different loci/labels do not establish causal discrimination.
decisions.outside_r1: hypothesis x scope x prediction/likelihood x observation window x revision criterion

decisions.decision: REDUNDANT_vs_X = EQUIVALENT(B3,X) AND (STRUCTURALLY_MORE_COMPLEX(B3,X) OR MATERIALLY_MORE_EXPENSIVE(B3,X)), X in B2/B4. Fixed structural relations true for both. No computed complexity score.
decisions.resource_advantage: Retain REDUNDANT_BY_STRUCTURE plus RESOURCE_ADVANTAGE_B3, not INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
decisions.supersedes: Cost-only redundancy implementation0.2; unrelated C1 harm is retained separately and can dominate overall status.

decisions.decision: Normal B0/B4 no PREP; B1/B2 exactly one; B3 at most one with normal skip only by B3 controller. Abnormal skipped PREP requires PROTOCOL_FAILURE / INFRA_FAILURE / EXPLICIT_NONEXECUTION.
decisions.accounting: Abnormal skip stays ITT; reason required; excluded from normal operational-mode evidence and architecture-savings claims. R1 task overrides older blanket infra exclusion for these specific PREP nonexecutions; ordinary non-PREP infra attrition remains separately reported.
decisions.configurable_field: capability_configurations.prep_policy; episode.execution_context.prep_skip_reason/prep_call_count; no discretionary B1/B2 normal skip
decisions.limit: Controller-driven call savings are a protocol-bundle effect, not proof of an internal autonomous mechanism.
